title: Follow Button
accessibility_notes: Reaction counts and follow state need accessible names that change with state, and threads need real heading or list structure.
ai_usage: Follow controls. Changing the label to 'Unfollow' on hover is conventional, but keep the accessible name stable at 'Following' so it is not announced as changing.
source:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Follow Button</title>
  <script type="application/json" id="effect-meta">
  {
    "id": "follow-button-states",
    "title": "Follow Button",
    "summary": "Follow, following, and unfollow-on-hover states.",
    "description": "Follow, following, and unfollow-on-hover states.",
    "theme": "social-ui",
    "categories": ["social", "feed"],
    "tags": ["social", "community", "follow", "state", "hover", "social"],
    "tech": ["css"],
    "era": "2020s",
    "difficulty": "intermediate",
    "dependencies": [],
    "browser_support": "All modern browsers (Chromium, Firefox, Safari).",
    "performance_notes": "Lightweight — composited transform/opacity work only.",
    "accessibility_notes": "Reaction counts and follow state need accessible names that change with state, and threads need real heading or list structure.",
    "customization": [
      { "name": "--c", "description": "Follow colour", "default": "#7c5cff" }
    ],
    "variations": ["Adapt to a light theme", "Compact variant for dense lists"],
    "ai_usage": "Follow controls. Changing the label to 'Unfollow' on hover is conventional, but keep the accessible name stable at 'Following' so it is not announced as changing."
  }
  </script>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; }
    body { display: grid; place-items: center; background: #0b0d12; color: #e7ebf3;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; }
    .fx { padding: .5rem 1.2rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #7c5cff; background: #7c5cff; color: #fff;
      font: inherit; font-weight: 700; font-size: .85rem; cursor: pointer; min-width: 110px; }
    .fx[aria-pressed="true"] { background: transparent; color: #e7ebf3; border-color: #3b465e; }
    .fx[aria-pressed="true"]:hover { border-color: #f87171; color: #f87171; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <button class="fx" type="button" aria-pressed="false" id="fb">Follow</button>
  <script>
    (function () {
      var b = document.getElementById("fb");
      b.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var on = b.getAttribute("aria-pressed") !== "true";
        b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(on));
        b.textContent = on ? "Following" : "Follow";
      });
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
